display_long_description:
This module provides training on the home under pressure. It equips you with the skills to identify common causes of house pressure issues, while ensuring compliance with safety codes. Through interactive learning sessions and virtual reality (VR) simulations, you will learn to assess, accurately document findings, and effectively communicate forensic analysis and repair recommendations to clients. Ideal for home inspectors and fireplace professionals, this module emphasizes safety protocols, hands-on practice, and documentation to enhance your expertise in home inspections.

**Responsibility & Worksite Hazard Assessment** – Operate in a simulated environment, identifying hazards commonly encountered during inspections of homes and chimneys.

**Familiarization** – Gain an understanding of different damage scenarios represented across the house as a system.

**Real-World Simulation** – Complete the inspection by accurately diagnosing potential issues with a focus on safety and forensic skills.

Any off-platform monetization of content in this app follows the Oculus Bulk IAP or Subscription Licenses app policy outlined here: https://developer.oculus.com/policy/app-policies
